rubrics.justification: The image is low-contrast and does not clearly show a well-defined ICM, cohesive TE, or confidently thinned zona; the response overcalls visible morphology and leans heavily on the provided 3AA grade rather than what can actually be verified from the image.
It integrates age, BMI, tubal factor, semen parameters, endometrial thickness, prior cycle history, and lifestyle factors well, including the important caveat about untreated hydrosalpinx.
The reasoning is structured and internally consistent, with prognosis tied to embryo quality and patient factors; only minor overconfidence in morphology limits a perfect score.

Recommendations are broadly evidence-based: single embryo transfer in a very young patient, caution against routine add-ons, and no rush to PGT-A after one failure. Minor soft spots include somewhat speculative exercise/alcohol counseling details around transfer.

Provides practical next steps for transfer and future planning, including SET, hydrosalpinx assessment, lifestyle optimization, and when to reconsider further testing; useful though not highly protocol-specific.
